newsitem.title: USA: Eric Douglas held in jail as drunk driving suspect.
newsitem.headline: Eric Douglas held in jail as drunk driving suspect.

text.p: Eric Douglas, youngest son of Hollywood star Kirk Douglas and brother of actor Michael, was held in jail overnight on suspicion of drunk and drug-impaired driving, police said Monday.
Douglas, 38, was initially held in lieu of bail but then released from the Long Beach jail early in the morning. He faces arraignment later this week.
He was detained by witnesses Sunday evening after crashing his rental car into two parked vehicles in the port city some 20 miles south of Los Angeles. No injuries were reported.
A police spokesman said Douglas allegedly tried to leave the scene of the accident and was detained, adding that he was suspected of driving under the influence of alcohol and drugs.
Last year, Douglas pleaded guilty in federal court in New Jersey to disrupting a Los Angeles-New York commercial flight. He was ordered to enter a detoxification centre for treatment.
In 1995, he agreed to a court-ordered drug programme to avoid narcotics charges following his arrest in a restaurant with an amount of cocaine.
And in 1992, he was placed on two years probation, jailed for five days and fined after kicking a police officer who tried to break up an argument between Douglas and his attorney.
